label: Verdict (4 of 6 agents): the claim is mostly wrong
detail: Partly built already. Gallabox (India, ₹2,399–13,599/mo) and Wati sell one inbox across WhatsApp, Instagram, website and calls, with AI qualification against custom rules and lead pipelines (4/5). Fin (formerly Intercom) and Freshworks (4/5), and Meta's free Business Agent (3/5) also qualify leads. Still open: email as a full channel in an SMB inbox; a business-defined match score with priority sorting as the core screen; a native sales CRM at SMB prices, India-first. Agents A (Kinso AI) and B (HighLevel etc.) were stopped and are not counted yet.
